blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Robust and reliable perception is essential for autonomous robots operating in real-world environments, particularly in long-term missions where environmental conditions may change significantly over time. Although recent advances in Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) have improved open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, these models can still suffer from domain shift, which can significantly degrade performance if they are not adapted to the current environment.
Training-free domain adaptation is a relevant paradigm for adaptation, consisting of adjusting the model online using lightweight adapters. Recent approaches apply this on a per-frame basis, which is impractical for deployments on resource-constrained robotic hardware.
To tackle this, we propose a multi-signal domain shift detection method for training-free continual test-time adaptation (TF-CTTA) in open-vocabulary segmentation. Our method leverages temporal coherence across consecutive frames by monitoring and combining complementary aspects of domain shift (visual change, adapter mismatch, and semantic drift) to trigger adaptation only when needed. We validate our approach on a benchmark including indoor and outdoor environments and using real robotic data. We demonstrate that our approach maintains segmentation accuracy while substantially reducing adaptations, making training-free adaptation practical and feasible for long-term, real-world robotic deployments.
blocks.zh:
对在现实世界环境中运作的自主机器人来说,特别是环境条件可能随时间而发生重大变化的长期飞行任务来说,强健可靠的感知是必不可少的。 虽然视觉基础模型(VFMs)的近期进步改善了开放-vocabliary语义分解,但这些模型仍然会受到域位移的影响,如果不适应当前环境,域位移会显著降低性能.
无培训域适应是一个相关的适应范式,包括使用轻量级适配器在线调整模型. 最近的办法按框架适用这一办法,这对于部署受资源限制的机器人硬件是不切实际的。
为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用多信号域移位检测方法,在开放的省区段进行无培训的持续试验时间适应(TF-CTTA)。 我们的方法通过监测和综合域转移的互补方面(视觉变化、适配器不匹配和语义漂移),在连续框架中利用时间一致性,只有在需要时才能触发适应。 我们在包括室内和室外环境以及使用真正的机器人数据在内的基准上验证我们的方法。 我们表明,我们的做法保持了分化的准确性,同时大大减少了适应,使无培训的适应在长期、现实世界的机器人部署方面切实可行。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: For autonomous robots operating in real-world environments, robust perception is essential, especially during long-term missions such as last-mile delivery, service robotics, or mobile assistance [ 1 ] . In these scenarios, a robot must navigate and understand scenes reliably across multiple and changing environments (e.g., alternating indoor and outdoor scenarios, new buildings, and varying illumination and weather). Such variability generates the well-known domain shift , which causes performance degradation if the model is not adapted to the current operational environment [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于在现实世界环境中运行的自主机器人来说,强健感知至关重要,特别是在如最后一英里送货,服务机器人,或移动援助等长期任务中. [1]. 在这些情景中,机器人必须在多种不断变化的环境中可靠地导航和理解场景(例如,室内外交替情景、新建筑以及不同的照明和天气)。 这种可变性产生众所周知的域位转移,如果该模型不适应当前的操作环境,则导致性能退化[2].

blocks.en: Recent advances in Visual Foundation Models (VFMs), particularly for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation [ 3 ] , have significantly improved robustness and generalization in out-of-distribution settings. Despite these zero-shot capabilities, VFMs can still suffer notable performance degradation under domain shift. Changes in scene type, appearance, lighting, or layout can lead to a noticeable decrease in the model’s accuracy, making adaptation necessary during deployment [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉基础模型(VFMs)的近期进展,特别是开放式语义分解[3],大大改善了分布外环境中的稳健性和通俗性. 尽管有这些零射能力,VFM在域位移下仍然会遭受显著的性能退化. 场景类型、外观、照明或布局的变化可导致模型的准确性明显下降,因此在部署过程中有必要进行调整[4]。

blocks.en: Although domain adaptation for semantic segmentation has been widely explored, a core challenge still remains: how to adapt models online without introducing computational burden (e.g., operational cost or system complexity) while maintaining task performance. A potential solution is to rely on Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) approaches [ 5 , 6 ] , consisting of fine-tuning the model online after each inference step. However, this paradigm can be impractical in real-world robotic deployments because online fine-tuning via backpropagation introduces computational overhead, latency, and memory demands on resource-constrained devices. A promising alternative is training-free adaptation in which the model is adjusted at inference time without gradient-based updates. This paradigm has recently been introduced by SemLA [ 7 ] , which proposes to dynamically fuse low-rank adapters into the model at test time, based on their proximity to the target domain.
blocks.zh: 虽然已广泛探索了语义分割的域适应,但一项核心挑战依然存在:如何在不引入计算负担(如运行成本或系统复杂性)的情况下在线调整模型,同时保持任务性能. 一个潜在的解决办法是依靠连续试验-时间适应(CTTA)方法[5,6],包括在每个推论步骤后对模型进行在线微调. 然而,这种范式在现实世界的机器人部署中可能是不切实际的,因为通过反向传播的在线微调引入了对资源约束设备的计算间接费用,耐久性和内存要求. 一个有希望的替代办法是无培训适应,在推断时对该模型进行调整,而不进行梯度更新。 这个范式最近由SemLA[7]提出,它提议在测试时,根据低级适配器与目标域的接近程度,将低级适配器动态地装入模型.

In this paper, we analyze SemLA for real-world robotic deployments, finding important practical limitations.
The method requires per-frame adapters retrieval and model updates, thus increasing energy consumption and introducing substantial runtime overhead, affecting real-time operation.
Furthermore, evaluations have mostly focused on general-purpose datasets, leaving evaluation on sequential robot data largely unexplored.

此外,评价主要侧重于通用数据集,使对顺序机器人数据的评价基本上没有得到探讨。

blocks.en: To avoid per-frame overhead, we propose a multi-signal domain-shift detector for identifying significant visual and semantic changes in image streams to trigger adaptation only when needed. While previous approaches relying on a single indicator (prediction entropy [ 8 ] or feature statistics [ 9 ] ) tend to saturate quickly and miss gradual changes, our approach detects shifts by monitoring three complementary aspects: (i) visual change, which captures abrupt scene transitions, (ii) adapter mismatch, which determines if the loaded adapters become inadequate for the current domain, and (iii) semantic drift, which identifies the appearance of novel semantic content. These signals are combined through a hierarchical fusion strategy that triggers adaptation only when multiple signals detect a domain shift.
blocks.zh: 为避免每帧高空飞行,我们提议采用多信号域-变换探测器,用于识别图像流中的重大视觉和语义变化,以便仅在需要时触发适应. 虽然以往的方法依赖于单一指标(预测式的entropy[8]或特征统计[9])往往会快速饱和并错过渐进式的改变,但我们的方法通过监测三个互补方面来检测变化:(一)视觉变化,它捕捉突然的场景过渡,(二)适配器不匹配,它决定了装入的适配器在目前领域是否变得不合适,(三)语义漂移,它识别了新语义内容的外观. 这些信号通过分级聚变策略进行组合,只有当多个信号检测到域位移时,才触发适应.

blocks.en:
Our framework, illustrated in Fig. 1 , integrates domain shift detection into a training-free continual test-time adaptation (TF-CTTA) pipeline for open-vocabulary segmentation used by mobile robots operating across indoor and outdoor environments. Rather than swapping adapters every frame like SemLA [ 7 ] , our solution exploits temporal coherence across consecutive frames, triggering adaptation only when a domain shift is detected. This reduces adaptation events by two orders of magnitude while maintaining segmentation accuracy, making training-free adaptation practical for long-term robotic deployment.
In summary, our contributions are as follows: • We analyze the performance of SemLA [ 7 ] on real-world robotic sequences, with a focus on indoor and alternating indoor-outdoor scenarios, identifying practical limitations of per-frame adaptation. • We introduce a domain shift detector that combines three complementary signals to guide the adaptation, reducing the overhead caused by per-frame adaptation while maintaining semantic segmentation quality. • We propose a continual test-time adaptation benchmark tailored to robotics, capturing alternating and temporally correlated domain shifts 1 1 1 The code and the benchmark will be released upon publication. .
Using this, we provide a comprehensive evaluation comparing our method for TF-CTTA with relevant baselines. • We demonstrate our approach on real-world sequences acquired with a robotic sensor across indoor and outdoor environments and benchmark inference on NVIDIA Jetson hardware.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) is a challenging task that focuses on enabling models to adapt in real-time to dynamic, changing environments, without access to the source data.
This task was initially introduced in the seminal work of [ 6 ] , where a neural network is fine-tuned online with the supervision of a teacher, which is updated as an exponential moving average of the student’s weights.
EcoTTA [ 10 ] improves the teacher-student framework using lightweight meta networks that are attached to the original frozen model, while ViDA [ 11 ] leverages visual domain adapters added to a source-pretrained model.
Moving toward more realistic deployment scenarios, [ 12 ] studies multi-modality test-time adaptation for semantic segmentation, leveraging multiple sensing modalities to improve robustness under domain shifts and highlighting the relevance of methods tailored for robotic perception.
Despite attractive, the aforementioned solutions present important limitations for real-world deployment, in terms of both inference speed and memory consumption, as they require backpropagation and weight sharing for EMA accumulations between two large architectures.
blocks.zh:
持续测试时间适应(CTTA)是一项具有挑战性的任务,它侧重于使模型能够实时适应动态,不断变化的环境,而无法获得源数据.
这项任务最初在[6]的开创性作品中被引入,其中神经网络在教师的监督下进行在线微调,更新为学生体重的指数移动平均值.
EcoTTA [10] 改进师生框架,使用与原冷冻模型相连的轻量级元网络,而ViDA [11] 则利用视觉域适配器添加到一个源预调节模型中.
走向更现实的部署情景,[12]研究了语义分解的多模式测试-时间适应,利用多种感知模式在域位变化下提高稳健性,并强调适合机器人感知的方法的相关性。
尽管有吸引力,但上述解决方案在推论速度和内存消耗方面对现实世界的部署提出了重要的限制,因为它们要求两个大型建筑之间对EMA积累进行反向传播和重量共享。

blocks.en: Training-free continual test-time adaptation (TF-CTTA) is a different paradigm that avoids expensive parameter updates by combining pretrained models relevant to the current domain, avoiding any additional training. [ 13 ] proposes a model merging technique, including parameter and buffer merging for multi-target domain adaptation tasks, applicable to any single-target domain adaptation model. Most closely related to our work, [ 7 ] introduces SemLA, a training-free test-time framework for open-vocabulary segmentation that leverages a library of LoRA-based adapters indexed with Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) embeddings [ 14 ] . The CLIP embeddings guide adapter selection, and subsequently, the most relevant adapters are merged based on their proximity to the target domain in the embedding space. Despite being intriguing, updating the model every frame strongly compromises real-time inference, remaining not practical for real-world robotic deployments.
blocks.zh: 免费培训的持续测试时间适应(TF-CTTA)是一种不同的范式,它通过结合与当前领域相关的预先训练过的模型,避免昂贵的参数更新,避免任何额外的培训. [13] 建议一种模式合并技术,包括参数和缓冲合并,用于多目标域适应任务,适用于任何单一目标域适应模式. 与我们的工作关系最密切的,[7]引入了SemLA,一个免费的开放-vocabulary分区测试-时间框架,利用一个基于LORA的适配器的库,该库以兼容语言-图像Pretraining(CLIP)嵌入[14]. CLIP嵌入式引导适配器选择,随后,最相关的适配器根据其靠近嵌入空间中的目标域而合并. 尽管这个模型很有趣,但每个帧的更新都强烈地损害实时推论,对于现实世界的机器人部署来说仍然不切实际.

blocks.en: Domain shift detection represents a valuable technique for reducing the model updates by identifying substantial changes in the robot’s perception stream that can cause performance degradation. In continual test-time adaptation, a natural solution is to leverage the discrepancy between the teacher-student predictions. The works of [ 5 ] and [ 15 ] compare the consistency loss between teacher and student accumulated with EMA with a variable threshold. [ 16 ] models domain shift directions via Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) and incorporates domain shift and class shift controllers to prevent category drifting.
blocks.zh: 域位移检测是一种宝贵的技术,通过识别机器人感官流中可导致性能退化的巨大变化来减少模型更新. 在持续的测试时间适应中,一个自然的解决办法是利用师生预测之间的差异。 [5]和[15]的作品将教师和学生之间累积起来的一致性损失与EMA的阈值可变进行比较. [16] 通过概念激活矢量器(CAVs)的模式域移位方向,并纳入域移位和类移位控制器,以防止类别漂移.

blocks.en:
Other approaches detect domain shifts by performing uncertainty estimation using a model trained on the source domain. In ViDA [ 11 ] , each sample is processed multiple times using dropout in the linear layers, and uncertainty is calculated as the variance across the outputs.
Similarly, [ 17 ] computes a threshold using an EMA by aggregating the maximum confidence values for each pixel calculated using multiple versions of the same sample obtained with data augmentation. The approaches of [ 18 ] and [ 19 ] estimate uncertainty using the average class-wise confidence of a source model accumulated in a sliding window with a threshold to identify domain changes.
Teacher-student and source-model uncertainty methods are impractical in our scenario, as deploying an additional segmentation model or running multiple forward passes for uncertainty estimation significantly compromises computational and memory efficiency.
blocks.zh:
其他方法通过使用在源域方面受过培训的模型进行不确定性估计来检测域位变化。 在ViDA [11]中,每个样本都使用线性层的退出处理多次,不确定性作为整个输出的差异来计算.
同样,[17] 使用一个EMA计算一个阈值,方法是将每个像素的最大置信值汇总在一起,这些置信值是使用通过数据扩增获得的同一样本的多个版本计算出来的。 [18] 和 [19] 的方法利用在滑动窗口中累积的源模型的平均类置信度估算不确定性,该模型具有识别域变化的阈值。
在我们的设想中,教师-学生和源模型的不确定性方法是不切实际的,因为部署一个额外的分块模型或运行多个前传通道进行不确定性估计,大大降低了计算和记忆效率。

blocks.en:
Domain shifts can also be detected by monitoring features or prediction statistics directly, with no secondary model. [ 9 ] proposes a domain shift signal based on the cosine distance between mean feature representations of consecutive batches from the source model, triggering when the signal exceeds a multiple of its moving average. More recently, [ 8 ] targets resource-constrained embodied devices, monitoring prediction entropy via EMA and adapting only when entropy deviates past a threshold.
Despite being more efficient, these methods are not robust enough for long-term sequences of robotic perceptions. Relying on a single indicator, they tend to saturate quickly as they cannot differentiate between types of domain shift. Our method, instead, combines multiple complementary signals for capturing different types of shifts and, relying on CLIP features, is specifically designed for the training-free domain adaptation framework of [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh:
域位变化也可以直接通过监测特征或预测统计来检测,没有二级模型. [9] 提出一个域位移信号,基于从源模型中连续批次的大小特征表示之间的余弦距离,当信号超过其移动平均值的倍数时触发. 最近,[8] 瞄准受资源约束的内含装置,通过EMA监测预测 en,只有在 en偏离阈值时才进行适应.
这些方法虽然效率更高,但对于机器人感知的长期序列来说不够有力. 依靠单一指标,它们往往会很快饱和,因为它们无法区分域转移的类型。 相反,我们的方法结合了多个互补信号来捕捉不同类型的转变,并依靠CLIP的特性,是为[7]的无培训域适应框架专门设计的.

Considering the sequential image streams perceived by robots in the wild, we propose a multi-signal domain shift detector that leverages temporal coherence to trigger adaptation only when a domain shift is detected, improving efficiency while maintaining segmentation accuracy.

blocks.en: IV Multi-Signal Domain Shift Detection

blocks.en:
The main limitation of applying SemLA on mobile robots is its per-frame adaptation. We observed that this requirement significantly compromises computational efficiency, as the model needs to be dynamically updated every iteration.
Since robotic perceptions operating in an environment are highly correlated, we overcome this limitation by proposing a multi-signal domain shift detection to trigger adaptation only when needed. Specifically, our method monitors three signals capturing complementary aspects of domain shift: the visual change ( S 1 S_{1} ), whether the loaded adapters still match the current domain ( S 2 S_{2} ), and the drift in the semantic objects appearing in the stream ( S 3 S_{3} ). The signals are fused hierarchically to trigger adaptation only when substantial evidence is detected across them, thus avoiding costly per-frame adaptation and making training-free adaptation practically deployable in robotic hardware.

由于在一个环境中运行的机器人感知高度相关,我们通过提出一个多信号域移位检测来克服这一局限性,以便仅在需要时触发适应. 具体地说,我们的方法监视三个捕捉域位移互补方面的信号:视觉变化(S 1 S_{1}),加载的适配器是否仍然匹配当前域(S 2 S_{2}),以及流中出现的语义物体中的漂移(S 3 S_{3}). 信号分级连接,只有在发现大量证据时才能触发适应,从而避免每帧适应费用昂贵,并使无培训适应在机器人硬件中可以实际部署。

blocks.en: V-A Experimental setup and benchmark design
blocks.zh: V-A 实验设置和基准设计

blocks.en: To evaluate our TF-CTTA approach in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation under domain shift, we design a benchmark that combines a variety of widely used indoor and outdoor datasets. The benchmark covers diverse scene types, label sets, and environmental changes (e.g., weather conditions) to better reflect long-term robotic perception under evolving domain shifts. In addition, we perform evaluation on real-world robotic data.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们在域移下的开放-省语义分解中采用的TF-CTTA方法,我们设计了一个结合各种广泛使用的室内室外数据集的基准. 该基准涵盖不同的场景类型,标签集,以及环境变化(如天气条件),以更好地反映在不断发展的域移中的长期机器人感知. 此外,我们还对现实世界的机器人数据进行评估。

blocks.en: Datasets. Our benchmark is constructed from two indoor and two outdoor datasets.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们的基准是根据两个室内和两个室外数据集构建的。

blocks.en: We use Scannet [ 21 ] and Scannet++ [ 22 ] , two large-scale indoor scene understanding datasets with diverse sensing modalities in multiple environment types, such as apartment , office , classroom , bedroom , etc. As in previous works [ 23 , 24 ] , each environment is treated as a separate domain, resulting in 707 and 906 unique domains for Scannet and Scannet++, respectively. For evaluation, we use the NYU40 label space [ 25 ] for Scannet and the top- 100 100 classes for Scannet++.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Scannet[21]和Scannet++[22],两个具有多种感知模式的大型室内场景数据集,如公寓,办公室,教室,卧室等多种环境类型. 和之前的作品[23,24]一样,每个环境都被当作一个单独的域,结果分别产生了707和906个Scannet和Scannet++的独特域. 为了评价,我们使用NYU40的标签空间为Scannet[25],使用Scannet++的上-100个班.

blocks.en: For outdoor contexts, we use ACDC [ 26 ] and MUSES [ 27 ] , two popular driving datasets where domains are represented by different weather and illumination conditions. More precisely, ACDC defines 5 domains: sun , night , rain , fog , and snow . MUSES extends this to 8 domains: 4 weather conditions ( clear , rain , fog , snow ) in 2 different light conditions ( day , night ). Both datasets are evaluated using their 19 standard object categories.
blocks.zh: 对于户外环境,我们使用ACDC [26] 和MUSES [27],两个流行的驱动数据集,其中域由不同的天气和照明条件代表. 更确切地说, MUSES将它扩展到8个域:4个天气条件(晴,雨,雾,雪)在两个不同的光线条件下(白天,夜晚). 这两套数据集都使用其19个标准对象类别进行评估.

blocks.en: Implementation details. We use SED [ 3 ] as the base model for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. Following [ 7 ] , we attach a LoRA [ 20 ] adapter to each linear layer of the model (except the text encoder), training one adapter per domain (1626 total adapters, ∼ {\sim} 10 MB each). Each adapter is trained until convergence. Since Scannet++ provides data from two hardware configurations (iPhone and DSLR camera), we train adapters using only iPhone data.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 我们使用SED[3]作为开放式语义分解的基础模型. 在 [7] 之后,我们将一个LORA [20] 适配器附加到模型的每个线性层(文本编码器除外),每个域培训一个适配器(1626个总适配器, \\\ sim}每个10 MB). 每个适配器都经过训练,直到汇合. 由于Scannet++提供来自两个硬件配置(iPhone和DSLR相机)的数据,我们只使用iPhone数据来训练适配器.

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol and metrics. To validate our approach, we propose a benchmark in which the model is tested through a sequence of domains, reflecting our continual test-time scenario described in Section III-A .
blocks.zh: 评价规程和衡量标准。 为了验证我们的做法,我们提出了一个基准,通过一系列域测试模型,反映第三节A所述我们持续试验时间的情况。

blocks.en:
We define a sequence 𝒯 \mathcal{T} alternating 16 domains 𝐄 t \mathbf{E}_{t} randomly chosen from the 4 indoor/outdoor datasets.
We compose a new label space containing all the object categories needed by the 4 datasets (removing repetitions). This reflects a real-world deployment where the model is prompted with all the objects a robot can find while operating.
Inside the sequence 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , we evaluate in a leave-one-out fashion: when running in 𝐄 t \mathbf{E}_{t} , the corresponding adapter trained in 𝐄 t \mathbf{E}_{t} is discarded, so the model is always tested on unseen scenes. This is a common setup in domain adaptation [ 23 , 24 ] where each environment is considered a different domain. To ensure fairness, the evaluation is repeated over 50 randomly sampled sequences.

我们定义一个顺序 T\ mathcal{T} 交替 16 域 E\ mathbf{ E} 从 4 个室内/室外数据集随机选择 。
我们构成一个新的标签空间,包含4个数据集所需的所有对象类别(删除重复). 这反映了一种现实世界的部署,即模型与机器人在操作时可以找到的所有物体一起被激发.
在序列 T\ mathcal{T} 中, 我们以留一出的方式评价: 当运行在 E t\ mathbf{E}_{t} 时, E t\ mathbf{E}_{t} 所训练的相应适配器被丢弃, 所以模型总是在看不见的场景中测试 。 这是一个常见的设置,在域名调整[23,24]中,每个环境都被认为是不同的域. 为确保公平,重复评价的随机抽样序列超过50个。

blocks.en: Comparative methods. To evaluate our approach for domain shift detection in TF-CTTA, we compare with the following strategies for triggering adaptation: • Zero-shot: the base model SED [ 3 ] without adaptation. • Entropy [ 8 ] : adapts when the exponential moving average of the prediction entropy deviates from a post-adaptation baseline beyond a threshold. • DSS [ 9 ] : triggers adaptation when a domain shift signal (cosine distance between mean feature representations of consecutive batches of images) exceeds a multiple of its moving average. We keep the threshold of the original paper but lower the batch size to 50 frames to make the method more reactive. • Periodic: adaptation is triggered every Δ f = 120 \Delta_{f}=120 frames, tuned to match the average number of domain changes (N A {}_{\text{A}} ) found by our method. • SemLA [ 7 ] : the adaptation process is triggered at each frame, with no mechanisms for domain shift detection.

blocks.en: V-B Results on training-free continual adaptation
blocks.zh: 关于无培训持续适应的成果

blocks.en: Table I reports the results of our method and the baselines tested in a continual test-time manner. Overall, our method achieves segmentation accuracy (mIoU) close to the SemLA approach that, by performing a per-frame adaptation, represents a performance plateau. At the same time, our approach is substantially more efficient in terms of the number of triggered adaptations (N A {}_{\text{A}} ). With only a marginal drop of 1.4 mIoU points compared to SemLA, our method triggers adaptation only 0.8% of the time.
blocks.zh: 表一以持续试验时间的方式报告我们的方法和基准的结果。 总体而言,我们的方法实现了离SemLA方法近的分化精度(mIoU),通过进行每帧的调整,它代表着一个性能高原. 同时,我们的做法在触发适应的次数方面要提高效率得多(N A QQText{A}})。 与SemLA相比,我们的方法只触发了0.8%的适应。

blocks.en: Compared to all these baselines, our method achieves the best performance in terms of segmentation accuracy in the majority of the splits (13 out of 16), except for 𝐄 𝟑 𝐈 \mathbf{E^{I}_{3}} , 𝐄 𝟏𝟎 𝐈 \mathbf{E^{I}_{10}} , and 𝐄 𝟏𝟓 𝐈 \mathbf{E^{I}_{15}} , in which Periodic leads by a margin of 0.3–0.5 mIoU. This demonstrates that our approach is capable of identifying domain shifts in a stream of robotic sensor data for effectively triggering adaptation. Notably, our method triggers roughly the same number of adaptations as Periodic but achieves higher segmentation accuracy, as it fires at actual domain transitions instead of fixed intervals. This confirms that when to adapt is as important as how often. It is also important to specify that this is an unrealistic baseline, as the frequency for adaptation has been set to mimic the efficiency reached by our method in this specific benchmark.
blocks.zh: 除了E 3 I\mathbf{E^{I}_{3}},E 10 I\mathbf{E^{I}_{10}},E 15 I\mathbf{E^{I}_{15}},其中周期领先0.3~0.5 mIOU. 这表明,我们的方法能够识别机器人传感器数据流中的域转移,从而有效启动适应。 值得注意的是,我们的方法触发的适应次数大致与周期性相同,但实现了更高的分化精度,因为它在实际域过渡时而不是在固定间隔时点火。 这证实,何时适应与多久适应同样重要。 还必须具体说明,这是一个不切实际的基线,因为适应的频率是用来模仿我们的方法在这一具体基准中达到的效率的。

blocks.en: The results also demonstrate a substantial improvement of our method over the baselines for domain shift detection, which show poor performance on long-term sequences of robotic perception. Specifically, Entropy [ 8 ] triggers adaptation a few times at the beginning but saturates quickly. This is because entropy is not a reliable signal in a training-free adaptation setting: since there is no online fine-tuning, the model does not progressively gain confidence on the current data, and a single peak in entropy can prevent subsequent adaptation. In contrast, DSS [ 9 ] identifies clear domain shifts, such as transitions from indoor to outdoor environments and vice versa, but it completely misses smaller domain shifts occurring within the same environment type, which our method captures by combining multiple signals.
blocks.zh: 结果还表明,我们的方法大大改进了域位移探测基线,显示机器人感知的长期序列表现不佳。 具体地说,Entropy [8]在开始时触发了几次适应,但快速饱和. 这是因为在无培训的适应设置中,Entropy不是一个可靠的信号:由于没有在线的微调,该模型不会逐渐获得对当前数据的信心,Entropy中单峰可以防止后续的适应. 相比之下,DSS[9]识别出清晰的域位转移,如从室内环境向室外环境的过渡,反之亦然,但它完全忽略了在同一环境类型内发生的较小域位转移,我们的方法通过组合多个信号来捕捉.

blocks.en: We perform an additional evaluation in out-of-distribution settings, namely when testing involves a camera model different from those used to train the adapters. This reflects real-world robotic deployment, where the robot’s camera often differs from the one used during training. We set up a library of adapters trained on Scannet and Scannet++ with iPhone data, with MUSES as the only outdoor dataset, and test them on Scannet++ using DSLR data (rectified images from a fisheye camera), and on ACDC for outdoor scenes. The results, shown in Table II , first confirm that training-free adaptation remains beneficial in out-of-distribution deployments (+4.4 mIoU over zero-shot). Furthermore, our method achieves performance comparable to per-frame adaptation, with a drop of only 0.4 mIoU, while triggering adaptation for a small fraction of the time (3.2 vs 960).
blocks.zh: 我们在分配外环境进行额外评估,即当测试涉及一个不同于培训适配器的相机模型时。 这反映了现实世界的机器人部署,机器人的相机往往与训练时使用的相机不同. 我们用iPhone数据建立了一个关于Scannet和Scannet++的适配器库,以MUSES为唯一的室外数据集,并使用DSLR数据(从鱼眼相机校验图像)在Scannet++上测试,并在ACDC上测试室外场景. 表二所示的结果首先证实,无培训的适应仍然有利于分配外部署(+4.4 mIoU 大于零射). 此外,我们的方法实现的性能与每帧适应相比,只有0.4 mIoU的下降,同时引发了一小部分时间的适应(3.2对960).

blocks.en: V-C Signal analysis
blocks.zh: V-C信号分析

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 shows the accuracy trade-off of individual signals and their combinations. Performance is evaluated as above, averaging over 50 sequences composed of 8 domains instead of 16.
Individually, S 1 S_{1} and S 3 S_{3} detect shifts frequently ( N A = 10.8 N_{A}=10.8 and 12.4, mIoU 44.9 and 45.3), while S 2 S_{2} barely triggers ( N A = 1 N_{A}=1 , mIoU 43.2), as adapter mismatch builds gradually and needs corroboration from the other signals.
Pairwise combinations expose the role of each signal and how they complement one another. S 1 + S 2 S_{1}+S_{2} is the most conservative combination ( N A = 1 N_{A}=1 , mIoU 42.9), and is dominated by S 2 S_{2} alone, without S 3 S_{3} the gradual semantic drift is never caught. S 1 + S 3 S_{1}+S_{3} triggers more often ( N A = 3.1 N_{A}=3.1 ) but obtains only a marginal improvement (mIoU 43.5). S 2 + S 3 S_{2}+S_{3} achieves the highest mIoU (45.5) but over-triggers ( N A = 14.4 N_{A}=14.4 ) since visual change is not considered.
Our full system achieves the best accuracy-to-adaptation trade-off ( N A = 4.1 N_{A}=4.1 , mIoU 44.7), staying within 1.3 mIoU of per-frame adaptation (46.0) while triggering 3.5 × \times fewer adaptations than S 2 + S 3 S_{2}+S_{3} . This confirms that the signals are individually sensitive but jointly selective, discarding spurious triggers while preserving detection coverage.

blocks.en: V-D Real-World Deployment
blocks.zh: V-D 实际世界部署

blocks.en:
We profile the pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin (32GB, NVMe SSD) mounted on our Spot robot, comparing per-frame adaptation (SemLA) against our triggered adaptation. Both are tested at two power levels (60W and 30W) and two model sizes to reflect different deployment scenarios. The image size is set to 224 × \times 224 and 384 × \times 384 for CLIP and SED, respectively.
Table III reports the per-component latency: domain navigation computed using CLIP (Domain nav.), the inference with the segmentation model (Seg. model), and adaptation cost (Adapt. cost). The domain shift signals introduce no additional model inference, operating on embeddings and predictions already available in the pipeline.
The results clearly show that adaptation is the bottleneck. While inference time can be reduced using smaller backbones, the adaptation cost is harder to cut as it is bounded by weight loading and merging. Even with our optimized adapter loading procedure compared to the original implementation [ 7 ] , which directly swaps adapters without creating new layers for storing them, each adaptation still takes on average 550ms at full power and 700ms at low power, more than CLIP and SED inference combined (except for the configuration with large models and low power). As a result, per-frame adaptation cuts throughput by 1.6–3.3 × \times , i.e., from 2.6 to 1.1 FPS at full power and from 0.8 to 0.5 FPS at low power with the large model. Since this cost is largely architecture-independent, minimizing the number of adaptations is a necessary condition for real-time deployment: with our triggered adaptation and the small model, the pipeline reaches 4.2 FPS at full power (3.2 × \times faster compared to the per-frame).

blocks.en: VI Conclusions
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose a pipeline for training-free domain adaptation with a multi-signal domain shift detector to trigger adaptation only when needed, substantially improving efficiency (3.3 × \times FPS) while maintaining accuracy.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出一个无培训域改造的管道,并配有多信号域移位探测器,仅在需要时触发适应,大幅提高效率(3.3 ×\times FPS),同时保持准确性.

blocks.en: In future work, we plan to investigate new strategies for indexing and merging adapters to improve segmentation accuracy and further reduce adaptation cost.
blocks.zh: 在今后的工作中,我们计划调查编制索引和合并适应器的新战略,以提高分化的准确性,进一步降低适应成本。
